summary.text: Dan Griffey is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 35-Position 1 since January 2015, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Jim Pierson.

paragraphs.text: Dan Griffey earned a high school diploma from North Mason High School and graduated from the Washington State Fire Training Academy in 1989.
His career experience includes working as a firefighter and an EMT.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he lives in Allyn, Washington, where he grew up, and worked for Central Mason Fire and EMS for more than 30 years before retiring.
Griffey assumed office in the Washington House on January 12, 2015.

In the survey, he named affordability, protecting the vulnerable and bringing business to Washington as key messages of his campaign, and said he has sponsored legislation removing the statute of limitations on felony sex crimes against children and creating the HOPE card for people with protection orders.
